user_story:
As a user, I want to view my shopping cart so that I can see the items I plan to purchase. The shopping cart should display the items with their quantity and a description, and I should be able to continue shopping or proceed to checkout. 
Acceptance Criteria:
- The page title should be 'Swag Labs'.
- The secondary header should display 'Your Cart' using the selector [data-test='secondary-header'].
- The shopping cart should contain buttons with the texts 'Continue Shopping' and 'Checkout' using the selectors [data-test='continue-shopping'] and [data-test='checkout'] respectively.
